title: runs --reconcile writes landed for a done item whose done commit is not yet on the integration main
goal: runs --reconcile leaves the run key of a done item at claimed until its done commit is on the integration main, and runs does not report such an item as drift

run:
import json,os,shutil,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P
T=os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py");COORD=os.path.abspath("_tools/coord.py")
d=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());rem=d/"remote.git"
s.run(["git","init","-q","--bare","-b","main",str(rem)],check=True);r=d/"clone"
s.run(["git","clone","-q",str(rem),str(r)],check=True,capture_output=True)
g=lambda *a:s.run(["git","-C",str(r),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
(r/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items","scratch_dir":"_cache/scratch","worktree_dir":"wt","land_push":["git","push","origin","HEAD:main"]}))
(r/"items").mkdir();(r/".gitignore").write_text("_cache/\nwt/\n");(r/"x.txt").write_text("x")
(r/"items"/"SP-cccccccc.json").write_text(json.dumps({"id":"SP-cccccccc","kind":"sprint","title":"s","status":"active","goal":"g"}))
(r/"items"/"ST-aaaaaaaa.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(id="ST-aaaaaaaa",kind="story",title="t",status="todo",priority="P3",goal="g",sprint="SP-cccccccc",touches=["x.txt"],checks=[{"run":["python3","-c","pass"]}]),indent=2)+"\n")
g("add","-A");g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm","i");g("push","-q","origin","HEAD:main");g("fetch","-q","origin")
env=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=str(d/"coord.sqlite"),CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID="chk",GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="x",GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="x@x",GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="x",GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="x@x")
bl=lambda *a:s.run([sys.executable,T,"--root",str(r),*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=120)
bl("claim","ST-aaaaaaaa","--by","claude-chk","--commit");g("push","-q","origin","HEAD:main")
(r/"x.txt").write_text("y");g("add","-A");g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm","work\n\nKB-Work: ST-aaaaaaaa");g("push","-q","origin","HEAD:main")
done=bl("done","ST-aaaaaaaa","--commit")   # the done commit stays local: not pushed, so not on origin/main
on_main=s.run(["git","-C",str(r),"log","origin/main","--format=%s"],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.count("done ST-aaaaaaaa")
bl("runs","ST-aaaaaaaa","--reconcile")
key=s.run([sys.executable,COORD,"get","run/ST-aaaaaaaa"],capture_output=True,text=True,env=env).stdout
state=json.loads(key).get("value") if key.strip().startswith("{") else key.strip()
shutil.rmtree(d,ignore_errors=True)
print("done exit",done.returncode,(done.stdout+done.stderr)[-300:],"| done commit on origin/main:",bool(on_main),"| run key after runs --reconcile:",state)
sys.exit(1 if state=="landed" and not on_main else 0)   # the key must not read landed before the done commit is on the integration main
